narrative.description: Beeple, the well-known NFT artist, posted something on X. This came weeks after he got involved in Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP memecoin, and it set off a same-name ticker swarm on Solana.
narrative.why_spreading: Beeple is a celebrity with a big following in crypto, and snipers mass-deploy tokens named after his posts. I could not read the post, so I don't know whether it actually endorses a token.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name only. It was not first (DMZt… launched about 9 minutes earlier) and it has much less market cap and volume than the leader.
token_connection.competing_tokens: DMZt… ($290k mcap, $801k h1 vol, leader), 4So8… ($26k mcap, $452k h1 vol), GG91…, 4Jqn… and several dead copies

authenticity.evidence: There are 687 unique buyers against 108 sellers, which suggests broad retail interest. But GMGN flags 74 bundler wallets, and the pool was a direct PumpSwap deploy whose creator holds all the LP. The swarm pattern of many copies is typical sniper and deployer farming.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the Beeple post itself or see any X discussion of this specific contract.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and was seeded by the creator, who can pull it at any time
Liquidity is larger than market cap, which fits an artificial direct-pool setup
It is a secondary copy that competes with a much larger leader for the same attention

structured_output.counterargument: Market cap is only $22k while the leader sits near $290k, so there is room to catch up. Buyers are accelerating (383 unique in the last 5 minutes), buys outnumber sells 2:1, the top 10 holders own just 14%, and mint and freeze authority are renounced. A second-place copy of a celebrity coin can easily double as spillover money arrives.
unknowns: What the Beeple post says and whether it names a contract

source_coverage.notes: I was very short on time. The X status fetch returned 403. News search turned up Beeple's recent involvement with $LAPTOP but nothing about a BEEPLE token. The project has no website or socials.

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical copy in a celebrity-tweet swarm, with fully unlocked, creator-owned LP and bundler activity. It has short-term momentum, but the rug risk is high and it has no claim to being the real token.
